notes: English default:15842 explicitly identifies the Ariad as elite scouts and skirmishers of the Alfar army; default:24356 calls it a unit, while default:20269/26891 describes its Klurikon scouting role. Japanese アリアド隊 and Chinese 阿瑞雅德精灵军 corroborate a named military unit, not a separate people/race. Reuse 아리아드(Ariad), replacing 아리아드대 with the same unit name and default:57979's misleading 아리아드인 with 아리아드(Ariad) 대원들. Register Ariad Camp as a distinct place and Shadow of the Ariad as a distinct complete item label, corroborated by Japanese アリアド隊のキャンプ/アリアドの影 and Chinese 阿瑞雅德营地/ 阿瑞雅德的暗影. Preserve the already covering camp annotation without nested parentheses. The official Korean manual PDF p. 1 distinguishes peoples and the war setting, p. 6 inventories equipment, and p. 7 describes faction quests; it does not name this unit. All three resources were searched, and existing related person/place dispositions remain intact.
